selection_basis: Unified representative audit inventory covering both Japanese and English surfaces. active_site_ids identifies the current focused cohort and is updated whenever live reruns change the current focus; verified match targets move back to the canonical reserve, while unresolved minor_gap, major_gap, quickjs_error, chrome_error, challenge_branch, and unverified_recently targets move into active verification subject to benchmark usefulness. Existing unresolved canonical reserves are promoted before previously audited unresolved sites are reintroduced. The complete inventory remains tag-filterable by dimensions such as jp/en and domain category.
